# WholeSMB

> Your guide to buying a profitable small business. How to find businesses for sale, evaluate them, finance the deal, and close — from laundromats to online stores.

## About
WholeSMB (wholesmb.com) is an independent content resource for people who want to buy a small business. We cover the full acquisition process: how to buy a business, due diligence, valuation, financing (SBA 7(a) loans and seller financing), and where to find businesses for sale by niche and location. We point buyers to marketplaces and brokers like BizBuySell, Flippa, and Empire Flippers. Operated by Bity LLC.

## Topics Covered
How to buy a small business, business acquisition due diligence, SBA 7(a) loans, seller financing, SDE valuation, business-for-sale marketplaces, and niche/local buyer playbooks (laundromats, online businesses, New Jersey). Updated regularly.
